name: Shakti dream session: chirp both sides, then hippocampus right
origin: Todd Murphy, 8 Coil Shakti (dream recipe; two-phase session design)
summary: The two-phase session Murphy's lucid-dreaming page names as an alternative: the chirp over both temporal lobes, then the hippocampal signal over the right temporal lobe, done an hour to 90 minutes before bed. Murphy writes that it 'can also be expected to elicit dream-related effects': that is his expectation, not a report, and he calls the chirp an untested signal.
setting: Dark, quiet room, at night, eyes closed; finish 1 to 1.5 h before going to bed.
schedule: Vendor rules: 60-min sessions at most once every 3 weeks; never on consecutive days.
notes: The vendor names this session and its timing, 'between an hour and 90 minutes before going to bed', but no lengths (lucid_dream.htm). Its run page offers 40- and 60-minute runs and shows 8 coils in photos, 2 on one side and 6 on the other (output_1_bi_mod40_chirp__2_r_hipp.htm). This program is the 60-minute run: 30 min of chirp on two coils per side (FT7, TP7, FT8, TP8), then 30 min of the hippocampal signal on four right coils (FT8, C6, TP8, T10). FT8 and TP8 serve both phases; the sites are this project's reading. The vendor builds its chirp from frequency-modulated gaps, with amplitude and gap length varied by the Fibonacci constant (mod40_chirp_consent.htm, TECHNICAL INFORMATION). The stand-in here is this project's plain sweep, falling from 40 to 6 Hz in 2.5 s, then 1.5 s off, on 3-ms points; it does not reproduce that build. The hippocampal stand-in is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]), then 4 s of silence. Both are rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's files are not published. Field strength: the session's sources give one figure, 50 mG, 'the level Shakti defaults to', with no measuring point (duds.htm). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The dream effect is the vendor's expectation, and it speaks of dream-related effects, not lucid dreams. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The vendor warns that the chirp can be 'very unpleasant over the right side'; if fear comes, press Skip to go to phase 2. Headache or pressure with hippocampal signals (vendor: about 2% of users): lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop at once on fear or any distress.
